name: חִדֶּקֶל
summary: Hiddekel is the Hebrew name of the Tigris, the third river of Eden, which flows east of Asshur. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: חִדֶּקֶל supplies the name in “the name of the third river.” The following clause describes its course east of Asshur.

note: Moved from the former word entry `7iddaeqael`. The old root key חדקל used the river name’s own consonants.
